summary: Nuvalent (NUVL) filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a definitive merger agreement with GlaxoSmithKline (GSK). GSK subsidiary Harmony Row Acquisition will launch a tender offer at $124.00/share in cash, representing the total per-share consideration for all Class A and Class B shares. The deal is structured as a tender offer followed by a Section 251(h) merger without a stockholder vote, subject to a minimum tender condition of a majority of Class A shares and HSR clearance. No financing condition applies. The board presumably recommends the offer. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and any competing bid emergence.
